description: Our healthcare system is fundamentally broken. Families in the Massachusetts 7th struggle with some of the highest per capita healthcare costs in the nation, even as they live in the shadow of some of the best healthcare institutions in the world. Transformational change is needed to shrink the deeply embedded disparities in our healthcare system […]
